description: Java class 'AmqpConsumerActor' that handles AMQP message consumption, including message processing, acknowledgment, consumer lifecycle management, and integration with Akka actors.

classes.name: AmqpConsumerActor
classes.description: Actor class for consuming AMQP messages, managing JMS consumers, processing messages, acknowledgments, and integrating with Akka.

classes.name: CreateMessageConsumer
classes.description: Inner class representing a request to create a new JMS message consumer.

classes.name: CreateMessageConsumerResponse
classes.description: Inner class representing the response containing the created JMS message consumer.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Akka Props for instantiating AmqpConsumerActor.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior for the actor.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Initializes the message consumer before actor starts.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Cleans up resources when actor stops.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming JMS messages by forwarding to self.

methods.name: stopMessageConsumer
methods.description: Stops the current JMS message consumer.

methods.name: startMessageConsumer
methods.description: Starts the JMS message consumer.

methods.name: stopMessageConsumerDueToRateLimit
methods.description: Stops consumer due to rate limiting.

methods.name: startMessageConsumerDueToRateLimit
methods.description: Restarts consumer after rate limit is lifted.

methods.name: getMessageRateLimiter
methods.description: Returns the message rate limiter instance.

methods.name: initMessageConsumer
methods.description: Initializes the JMS message consumer.

methods.name: destroyMessageConsumer
methods.description: Destroys the JMS message consumer.

methods.name: matchesOwnConsumer
methods.description: Checks if a consumer closed event matches the current consumer.

methods.name: handleConsumerClosed
methods.description: Handles the event when the consumer is closed, including requesting a new consumer.

methods.name: messageConsumerCreated
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new message consumer.

methods.name: messageConsumerFailed
methods.description: Handles failure in creating a message consumer.

methods.name: handleJmsMessage
methods.description: Processes received JMS messages, extracts headers and payload, and forwards to processing.

methods.name: acknowledge
methods.description: Acknowledges a message with success or failure, handling redelivery if needed.

methods.name: extractPayloadFromMessage
methods.description: Extracts payload from JMS message and populates ExternalMessageBuilder.

methods.name: extractHeadersMapFromJmsMessage
methods.description: Extracts headers from JMS message.
